correctness.rationale: The claim is finite and completely exhausted. Two independently written predicates agree on every tested six-subset; all 8008 six-subsets were checked, exactly 656 pass, and all 11440 seven-subsets fail in both predicates. Heredity then excludes every larger code. The 384 Hamming isometries were generated explicitly, preservation of three-sum equality follows coordinatewise, and exact orbit partition gives six classes with sizes summing to 656. The finalized standalone verifier was replayed from its packaged path.

value.rationale: The object is a standard higher-order additive uniqueness code with a direct three-user shared-codebook adder interpretation, not an arbitrary slice. The case \(h=3\) is the first higher-order setting beyond Sidon/\(B_2\) behavior, and a complete finite optimum plus symmetry classification gives a reusable exact benchmark for constructions and search algorithms. The six inequivalent extremal geometries show that the equality layer has genuine structure rather than being a single routine witness.
